package auth

import "context"

func IndividualPerformanceOf(ctx context.Context) (allowed, bound bool) { return false, false }

type OffError struct{}

func (OffError) Error() string { return "individual performance is off" }

// Require refuses while the switch is off.
func Require(ctx context.Context) error {
	if allowed, _ := IndividualPerformanceOf(ctx); !allowed {
		return OffError{}
	}
	return nil
}

// Catalog answers names and definitions, and no figure.
func Catalog() []string { return []string{"won"} }
